**Wednesday 18 November 2026** · Department of Real Estate and Planning,
Henley Business School, University of Reading

How far can modelling help a city plan its schools? Using Brighton &
Hove's secondary school system as a case study, this talk looks at what AI
and collective intelligence can add to applied urban modelling, drawing on
a model of the system built entirely from published data.

The model and its documentation:
[Brighton & Hove’s secondary school system](https://adamdennett.github.io/bh-school-system/).

The same talk, at other venues:
[Brighton AI](../2026-11-04-brighton-ai/) and the
[University of Glasgow](../2026-11-13-glasgow-geospatial-data-science/).
